description: Source code for translating PDCCH MAC layer data into FAPI protocol format, including functions for setting BWP, CORESET, precoding, and DCI parameters.

methods.name: fill_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets BWP parameters in the PDCCH PDU builder based on BWP configuration and CORESET configuration.

methods.name: calculate_coreset0_freq_res_bitmap
methods.description: Calculates frequency resource bitmap for CORESET0 based on its CRBs.

methods.name: fill_coreset_parameters
methods.description: Sets CORESET parameters in the PDCCH PDU builder.

methods.name: fill_precoding_and_beamforming
methods.description: Sets precoding and beamforming parameters in the DCI PDU builder.
